meta.title: Our Family Page
meta.textType: functional: a family page with names, ages, and likes

paragraphs: My name is Lily, and I am nine years old. Teacher Kim asks my class for a family page. I write mine at home on Sunday. This is my family. My brother Tom is eleven, and he is very tall. He is taller than I am. Tom is good at football. Mom has long black hair. Dad has short black hair. Mom and Dad both work. They come home at six o'clock. Mom is good at making soup, and Dad is good at fixing things. Dad is the tallest person in our family.

Grandpa has a bushy white mustache. He is seventy years old. Grandma is his wife. She has short gray hair. Tom asks, "How old is Grandma?" Grandma says, "I am the same age!" Grandma knows everything about the garden. She tells the best stories in the family. I think Grandpa's stories are funny. Tom thinks they are always the same. On Saturday we go to Grandma and Grandpa's house. We eat lots of fruit there.

Our puppy is called Pip. He is small and brown. I think Pip is the funniest of all! He runs after his red ball every day. He is the loudest dog in the street, too. Pip likes the garden, too. That is my family page. Now you write one! "Who is in your family?" "What are you good at?" I am good at drawing. Most days I draw Pip.
text.summary: Lily writes a family page for Teacher Kim. She tells us about Tom, Mom, Dad, Grandma, Grandpa, and Pip, and she asks two questions.
